paper_metadata.title: A quantifiable and automated volume fraction characterization technique for secondary and tertiary γ′ precipitates in Ni-based superalloys

evidence.quote: A quantifiable and automated volume fraction characterization technique for secondary and tertiary γ′ precipitates in Ni-based superalloys

This study presented a new method for determining the volume fraction of secondary and tertiary γʹ precipitates in Ni-base superalloys using low kV secondary electron SEM imaging and image processing.
